quests.name: Crystalline Elements
quests.objective: Bring Mayena Earthseeker a Moist Crystal, a Charged Crystal, a Noxious Crystal and a Fiery Crystal from Shaper's Terrace.

quests.name: Essence of Seeping Slimes
quests.objective: Gather 8 Seeping Slime Essence in the Shaper's Terrace.

quests.name: The Dark Crystal
quests.objective: Gather a colorless Drained Crystal Fragment near the Achromatic Crystal in the Shaper's Terrace.

quests.name: Panic at the Digsite
quests.objective: Slay Venomridge, 6 Ravasaur Matriarchs and 8 Ironhide Ravasaurs in Shaper's Terrace.
quests.description: Quest giver not known yet. The quest text asks for 9 Ironhide Ravasaurs, its objective counts 8.

quests.name: Mapping the Way Forward
quests.objective: Find Interesting Landmarks in Shaper's Terrace and fill out the explorer's map at each: the Pillar of Assimilation, the Achromatic Crystal, the Western Gates, the Regrowth Vestibule and the Unearthed Stone Watcher.
quests.description: Quest giver not known yet. You map them with an Explorers' League Cartographer's Kit.
